## Verified against real layouts vs reconstructed

Authorized read-only inspection of the original workbooks (Google Drive connector) was used to verify STRUCTURE only (sheet roles, headers, row shapes). No personal content was copied.

Verified (read from real files):
* EPH master family (two versions): a summary sheet with a label/value block ("Primary degree", "CPA jurisdiction") and a "51 earned" subtitle; a completed-credits ledger; degree-block ledgers and provider views sharing one 16-column header (Seq, Requirement Block, TESU Requirement, Course, Provider, Credits, Level, Completed / Remaining, Degree Placement, Writing / Assignment Burden, Exam Type, Prerequisite / Sequence Note, CPA Accounting?, CPA Business?, Status, Notes) under title and note rows, with TOTAL rows; a licensing audit sheet (Subject, Course / source, In 24-count?); an "Execution Order" sheet (Seq, Phase, Step, Course / action, Provider, Credits, ...); a validation sheet. Statuses Done / To take / Hold / Watch / Do not take; provider values such as "CSM Learn — HOLD"; note phrases such as PREAPPROVE, PROVISIONAL, Fallback, "After ACC-2010".
* A companion class-list workbook (Done / provider-to-take / Master tabs) for the same student.

* RUT degree workbook: START HERE, WEEK BY WEEK, SOPHIA TRACKER (Course, Challenges, Done, Milestones, Done, Score %, Status, % Work Complete), STUDY.COM TRACKER (Course, Content Ch., Done, Papers, Papers Done, Finish Target, Status), DASHBOARD, LUMIERE HUB.
